sourceRegistry.title: Enterprise managed settings enforcement updates
sourceRegistry.factSummary: Enterprise administrators can require supported Copilot clients to retrieve current managed settings at startup. With this requirement enabled, a client stops if it cannot confirm current policy; this is not the default for every user.

sourceRegistry.title: Code scanning AI Scan metrics in security overview
sourceRegistry.factSummary: GitHub added AI Scan metrics showing findings, resolutions and trends to security overview. This is a public preview for eligible GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security customers on github.com, not all deployments.

sentences.english: Mona: How many issues are in the report?
Karim: Three issues.
Mona: How many have been resolved?
Karim: One issue has been resolved.
Mona: So there are two issues left.
Karim: Right, let us review them together.
Mona: Is this yesterday’s report?
Karim: No, this is today’s report.
Mona: The number is lower than yesterday.

concepts.title: How many? One, two, three
concepts.explanation: Kaam is followed by a singular noun in this question: kaam moshkela? One issue is moshkela waahda. Two uses the dual ending -teen: moshkelteen. With three use the plural: talaat mashaakel.

concepts.title: Less and more
concepts.explanation: Aʾall means less or fewer; aktar means more. Men introduces a comparison: aʾall men embaareh, less than yesterday. Waʾt aktar means more time. With el-ʿadad there is no separate present-tense is.

examples.english: The number is lower than yesterday.

lessons.title: Kell egy frissítés
lessons.subtitle: October 13, 2026 · An update is needed
objectives: Describe closing and restarting a program.

readings.title: Current settings at startup · October 13 announcement

sentences.text: A GitHub új beállítást jelentett be.
sentences.english: GitHub announced a new setting.

sentences.text: A rendszergazda friss szabályokat kérhet a Copilot indításakor.
sentences.english: The administrator can require current rules when Copilot starts.

sentences.text: Ezzel a beállítással a program csak ellenőrzött szabályokkal indul.
sentences.english: With this setting, the program starts only with verified rules.

sentences.text: Anna: Melyik verzió van a gépen?
sentences.english: Anna: Which version is on the computer?
Bence: The old version.
Anna: An update is needed.
Bence: Now or later?
Anna: First I close the program.
Bence: Okay, then we update.
Anna: Is the update finished?
Bence: Yes. I restart the program.
Anna: Where are the settings?
Bence: Here, in this menu.
Anna: The version is correct now.
Bence: Then we can start.

example.english: Which version is on the computer?

concepts.title: Something is needed
concepts.explanation: Kell plus a noun says something is needed: kell egy frissítés. Nem kell negates it. It does not identify who needs it. In a question, intonation makes Kell egy frissítés? mean Is an update needed?

examples.english: A new program is not needed.

concepts.title: Close it and restart it
concepts.explanation: Bezárom and újraindítom are first-person definite forms: I close it and I restart it. The specific object has -t: a programot. Use először and utána to give the sequence. Később means later without specifying an exact time.
